description: Three drafts of one Instagram DM in the brand's voice, for an automation's first message (purpose first), a follow-up (followup) or the ask for an email (email_ask). Pass automation_id to write for that automation. context (up to 300 characters) says what to mention; tone warmer or shorter nudges the wording; avoid lists words to keep out. by says who wrote them: assistant, or template when the assistant is unavailable (three variants of the automation's own wording). Every draft is checked for the copy rules and 300 characters. Nothing is saved or sent: put the one you pick in dm_automation_update steps or dm_followup_send.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
